title: Epic Games ends 3 Fortnite game modes following 1,000-person layoffs
content: Following its layoff of over 1,000 employees, Epic Games is ending three Fortnite game modes as the company restructures its live operations team. The cuts to Fortnite's game mode portfolio follow CEO Tim Sweeney's acknowledgment that Epic had been spending beyond its means despite Fortnite remaining 'one of the most successful games in the world.'
